oneLine: Mahindra sells majority stake in Novavaayu Aerospace to Embraer for Rs 5,100 crore

sources.title: Mahindra to sell majority stake in aerospace subsidiary to Brazil's Embraer for Rs 5,100 crore

synopsis: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd has entered into an agreement to sell a 51% equity stake in its aerospace subsidiary, Novavaayu Aerospace Ltd, to Brazil-based Embraer SA for approximately Rs 5,100 crore. Following the acquisition, Novavaayu Aerospace will cease to be a wholly owned subsidiary of Mahindra and will become an associate of Mahindra Defence Systems Ltd. The transaction is expected to be completed on or before December 1, 2026.
